Training and Education
Are you planning for a Delinea Platform upgrade, integration, or migration?
We can help!
The Delinea Platform is at the center of Delinea’s identity security strategy. It helps customers centralize visibility into and control over their environments, enabling them to deploy capabilities more quickly and easily, and thereby accelerates their path to identity security maturity.
The Delinea Professional Services team can meet you wherever you are to help you maximize the value of your existing investments – while also allowing you to take advantage of Delinea Platform capabilities and benefits. We can help you:
Upgrade from Secret Server Cloud to Secret Server on the Delinea Platform
Migrate from Secret Server on premise to Secret Server on the Delinea Platform
Integrate Server Suite with the Delinea Platform
Where appropriate, migrate from Cloud Suite or hyper-scalable Privilege Access Service (HSPAS) to the Delinea Platform
Migrate from third-party products to capabilities on the Delinea Platform
From design to deployment to optimization,
Delinea Professional Services delivers rapid value in identity security.
We work side-by-side with your team to kickstart deployments, streamline integration, strengthen identity security controls, and ensure long-term success. E

Our methodology
Train & enable
Training is an important step toward laying a solid foundation for your identity security journey. Delinea provides flexible and robust training options to enable all levels of stakeholder, from business users to technical teams and admins. The types of training available to customers and business partners include:
Free training
, delivered through
Delinea University
.
Additional free resources
and access to virtual and in-person customer-only events, delivered through the Delinea customer community,
Secret Society
.
Instructor-led training
appropriate for all types of stakeholders, from business users to administrators, available via live webinars or 3-day, 4-day, and 5-day courses.
Learn more
.
The Delinea Certification Program
helps you gain the skills you need to distinguish yourself from other cybersecurity professionals and build your profile.
Learn more
.
Reach out to us to learn more
Plan & deploy
Delinea offers Xcelerate professional services packages to help new customers streamline the planning and deployment phases and realize value quickly. Xcelerate packages provide a Delinea-certified consultant to guide you through strategic planning and deployment, as well as to share Delinea best practices. The consultant also will support you as you take the steps to configure core features within your solution. This is a great way to provide the knowledge transfer that new users need, empowering you with hands-on experience and helping you grow your expertise and independence.
Xcelerate packages include, but are not limited to:
Delinea Platform
–
Secret Server Xcelerate Package
, as well as Platform Xcelerate packages for
Privileged Remote Access, Identity Threat Protection, Continuous Identity Discovery
, and
Privilege Control for Servers
Delinea Secret Server On-Premise
Package
Delinea Privilege Manager
Xcelerate Package
Delinea Server Suite Xcelerate Package
For customers that need help with more complex environments and use cases, the Delinea Professional Services team can also provide consulting support and custom services tailored to your specific goals and requirements.
Reach out to us to learn more
Adopt & mature
Given the dynamic and expanding nature of cybersecurity threats, identity security is not a once-and-done endeavor. To keep your organization ahead of identity security threats, it is essential to continually develop your skills and solutions. To support these efforts, the Delinea Professional Services team offers Enablement and Advisory Days to help you continue progressing – sharing best practices, tips for onboarding users, secrets, systems, integrations, and more.
The Professional Services team also offers
Maturity Assessments
to analyze and assess your current deployment, review your goals and strategy, and help you map out a short-, mid-, and long-term identity security journey that is aligned with your organization’s needs.
Lastly, for customers
who
want the comfort of having a Delinea-certified expert on hand for any reason, Delinea also offers
Resident Engineer
services. A Resident Engineer is a dedicated resource that brings their expertise to you to augment your staff, for six months or longer, to provide ongoing assistance, coaching, and support.
Reach out to us to learn more
Optimize & expand
For customers ready to optimize their identity security solutions and expand to support new use cases, Delinea offers
Health Checks
. Health Checks help you achieve identity security maturity and ensure you are realizing the full value of your solutions.
Health Checks provide ongoing evaluation of your identity security posture, performance, and risks, and recommend improvements and paths to adopt those improvements. The Delinea Professional Services team offers the following types of Health Checks:
Security and performance reviews – to assess user access polices, security protocols, and infrastructure currency and gaps
Risk identification reviews – to find security weaknesses, risky accounts, and potential threats within your environment
Compliance and best practice reviews – to assess if your identity security environment is compliant with industry standards and suggest improvements.
